statement: The entire middle-core mixing mechanism frozen in checkpoint002 is also Schmidt-number-at-most-two for EVERY complex t. This is a whole-route obstruction, not a point-grid exclusion or full P44 negative.

definitions.PPT: The exact local-filter image of frozen R45 under Bob4->t*Bob1, with Bob0..3 fixed; positivity, trace normalization and PPT follow. No numerical assertion is imported.

small_parameter_decomposition.phase_set: Z5, the five exact fifth roots of unity
small_parameter_decomposition.rank_proof: r2=z^2*r0-z*r1 and r3=-t*z^(-1)*r0+t*z^(-2)*r1. Hence every psi_z has Schmidt rank at most two.
small_parameter_decomposition.average: (1/5)sum_z P(psi_z)=P(a)+P(c)+P(d_t)+|t|^2P(g), since exponents0,1,-2,-3 are pairwise distinct modulo5
small_parameter_decomposition.scope: All coefficients are nonnegative under the hypothesis; all residual vectors contain at most two product terms.

large_parameter_decomposition.phase_set: Z3, the three exact cube roots of unity
large_parameter_decomposition.rank_proof: The first two coefficient-matrix rows are (1,z^(-1),0,0) and (z,1,0,0), the second being z times the first; the third row is (0,-z,1,0) and the fourth is zero. Rank is at most two.
large_parameter_decomposition.average: (1/3)sum_z P(phi_z)=P(a)+P(c)+P(h), since exponents0,1,-1 are distinct modulo3
large_parameter_decomposition.scope: All coefficients are nonnegative under the hypothesis; the residual vectors have Schmidt rank at most two.

all_parameter_cover: The regimes |t|^2<=3 and |t|^2>=1/3 overlap and cover every complex t, including t=0. Use the large formula when |t|^2>=1/3 and the small formula otherwise. Divide by the strictly positive trace and normalize nonzero vectors to obtain a finite convex Schmidt-rank-two decomposition. A universally2-block-positive negative separator therefore cannot exist for this entire mechanism.
